conclusion: Visible recall improved while true external occlusion rejection degraded sharply. Neither new model is adopted; reliable visibility/external occlusion remains unsolved.

definitions.end: Fixed selected-end geometric quads/camera projection, classmap registered against target-onlyBEFORE, projected through exact96fullcropbilinear samples. Visible means same targetpart/triangle/depth as BEFORE. Foreignfront means sourceforeign999 depth in front of an otherwise registered target-supported endpatch. Any positive sampled visible/foreignmass gives independent YES; BOTH permitted; self/ambiguity/registration/out-of-frame remainUNKNOWN. No sampled endmass means visibleNO/foreignUNKNOWN, never nativeE.
definitions.literal_owner: Separate central2x2 of fixed96 grid at [47:49]^2 with fourtap raster owner rawmass. Synthetic T aggregates anytargetpart, F999, BG, AMBIG/INVALID separate. Public253 assistantweak literal-center owner and CF314 selected-anchor opaque-cover/sham owner-only; not nativevisibility/qualitygold.
definitions.training: Five equal mean losses, supportBCE only synthetic; public253/CF314 ownerCE only. Shared trunk may couple representation, but ownerFOREIGN is not a direct foreign-support target. No new model or architecture conclusion.
